'''North Ascin Street''' was a street located in the second district of the city of [[Ciran]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cirrus]]. In [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]], the [[Fry family]] hid from [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in a gray stone building on this street.
